Documentary Screening: 10 Good Men

Description
Join Southbridge Theater for a special screening of 10 Good Men, a documentary that offers an opportunity to experience a compelling story on the big screen. Two showings will be available: Saturday, November 7th at 11:30 AM and Sunday, November 8th at 2:30 PM. Admission is free for veterans, making this a great opportunity to come together and enjoy this special film. All are welcome to attend! For more information and ticket details, visit https://www.facebook.com/events/1109960828405828.
